race.title: Frontline Security Grabel Mares Hurdle (Listed)
race.verdict: A listed mares hurdle in which OLDSCHOOL OUTLAW looks the most solid option on the pick of her form last season. Savante heads the list of dangers from Alliteration . OLDSCHOOL OUTLAW (IRE) SAVANTE (IRE) ALLITERATION (IRE)
